name: Ferreteria Mendez
summary: An authenticated web management system currently used by a hardware store for sales, quotations, products, inventory, invoicing, and business analytics.
functions: Handles counter sales, customer quotations, product management, PDF invoicing, API integrations, and reports on sales, profits, employee shares, and product performance.
problem: The company needed to connect daily sales and quotations with stock, invoicing, and reliable analysis of revenue, profitability, products, and employee activity.
solution: I developed a role-based web platform that centralizes commercial operations and turns transaction data into reports by day, period, product, profit, and employee.

demo.title: Private production system
demo.description: The platform is currently used by the company and cannot be public because it contains confidential financial, product, sales, and employee data.
